name: MIYACHI MELANCHOLY!
source:
Dudes, picture this:

You just got a text from your girlfriend asking to go out on a date! You rush over to find her...ooooonly to also find out that you have nowhere planned to go! Wuh oh! Big problem! And even bigger problem is that you're a broke teen! Luckily for you, you have an arsenal of really boring places to go! Yippee! 

[From [url=https://shinitai-tan.itch.io/miyachi-melancholy]itch.io[/url]]
